scope: Current-reachable execution binding/readiness only: canonical O2 V1 replay, exact one-to-one O2→W2 binding, CLOSED predecessor, ROUTED own state, evidence fail-closed, zero/one capacity gate, deterministic selection, no mutation, live session recheck authoritative. Parallel multi-ready selection is deferred to R5B.

amendments.authority: pre-admission instrument correction after O2 canonical-replay review
amendments.cause: The initial R5 freeze used a synthetic branched/multi-ready graph. O2 V1 canonically serializes every compiled graph and O3 requires byte-identical canonical replay, so the parallel scenarios were unreachable from current canonical O2. The instrument was narrowed before admission rather than legislating future graph behavior.
amendments.changed: R5A now adds canonical O2 replay integrity and tests only current-reachable serial readiness/capacity. Multi-dependency and multi-ready parallel scheduling move to unopened R5B.
amendments.unchanged: Exact planned→runtime binding, one-to-one identity, CLOSED-only dependency satisfaction, ROUTED-only own eligibility, missing-evidence fail-closed, no mutation, and live session recheck authority.
